input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_type.description: WGS, local 16S sequence identification, or independent WGS and 16S branches in one run.

input_format.description: Format of --samplesheet: fastq for reads to assemble, fasta for existing genome assemblies. --fasta_samplesheet always contains FASTA assemblies.

samplesheet.description: WGS CSV interpreted using --input_format. Defaults to samplesheet.csv only when neither --fasta_samplesheet nor --fasta supplies explicit WGS inputs.

fasta_samplesheet.description: Additional WGS assembly CSV with sample_id,fasta; may accompany a FASTQ --samplesheet in the same run.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

fasta.description: WGS assembly FASTA path or quoted glob; can supplement a FASTQ samplesheet.

rrna16s_samplesheet.description: 16S CSV with sample_id,fasta. Supply this or --rrna16s_fasta.

rrna16s_fasta.description: Prepared 16S nucleotide FASTA path or quoted glob.

rrna16s_db.description: Local decompressed NCBI 16S BLAST database, taxdb files and database.json.

run_id.description: Sequencing run ID for the final report.

comparison_options.title: Genome comparison options
comparison_options.description: Species-group genome similarity, optional SNP analyses and result collection.

snp_groups.description: Deprecated parameter; use snp_references. Supplying this parameter produces a migration error.

run_genome_similarity.description: Run Mashtree separately for each species group.

run_snp_phylogeny.description: Run Snippy using a supplied local reference for each selected species group.

collect_results.description: Collect declared pipeline outputs for downstream reporting.

snp_recombination.description: Use Gubbins for eligible Snippy alignments before filtered distances and tree inference.

snp_min_core_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of shared callable sites required for Snippy comparisons.

run_ska_snp.description: Run reference-free SKA2 alignment and SNP distances per species group.

comparison_species.description: Optional comma-separated species slugs to compare.

comparison_groups_dir.description: Prepared species-group directory path or quoted glob for comparisons.nf.

snp_references.description: Local CSV with species_slug,reference columns; one reference FASTA per group.

ska_kmer.description: Odd split-kmer length used by SKA2.

comparison_python_container.description: Public container image for comparison python.

snp_dists_container.description: Public container image for snp dists.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory to use for each process

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs to use for each process

max_time.description: Maximum time to use for each process

speccheck_criteria_file.description: Optional criteria CSV path for the in-pipeline speccheck stage. Defaults to /app/criteria.csv inside the speccheck container.

speccheck_template_file.description: Optional HTML template path for the in-pipeline speccheck summary stage. Defaults to /app/templates/report.html inside the speccheck container.

rrna16s_min_identity.description: Minimum identity percent for a candidate match; not a universal species cutoff.

rrna16s_min_coverage.description: Minimum query coverage percent for one alignment.

rrna16s_min_length.description: Minimum query length for a reportable candidate match.

rrna16s_max_ambiguous.description: Maximum fraction of ambiguous nucleotide bases.

rrna16s_score_window.description: Retain qualifying candidates within this percent of the best bit score.

rrna16s_max_hits.description: Maximum reported subjects per query; reaching this cap is flagged.
